text: Without design/tokens.css the reply MUST be the one fixed sentence and NEVER any file.
checklist: With no design folder the reply is exactly the fixed sentence of layer 06 and no file is written

text: Each turn MUST do one step only, spec or code, and end with design/STATUS.md updated and the exact words to continue.
checklist: One step per turn; STATUS.md updated; the continue words are in the reply

text: A spec turn MUST cover 3 to 4 components of the set; more asked go to STATUS.md.
checklist: At most four specs written; the rest are in components_pending

text: Every spec MUST have the ten sections and the eight states.
checklist: spec-check prints SPEC CHECK PASSED for every spec

text: Specs and code MUST name variables by exact CSS names from design/tokens.css, component variables first, never a raw value or palette step.
checklist: Every variable exists in tokens.css; component variables are used where they exist; no palette step

text: A missing variable MUST be replaced by the nearest semantic one and listed under Variables to add; variables.json and tokens.css are never edited.
checklist: Variables to add is in the spec and STATUS.md; tokens.css and variables.json unchanged

text: The code step MUST start from an existing spec; with none the reply is the fixed sentence and no code.
checklist: No code was written for a component without a spec

text: Code MUST use the project's own stack and never a raw hex, colour function or px size where a variable holds it.
checklist: CODE CHECK PASSED and the stack matches the project

text: The checker MUST be run as one plain command and its result line quoted; never report passed without PASSED.
checklist: The reply quotes the checker's output and its result line

text: Code MUST follow the keyboard and ARIA contract of its spec with native elements first.
checklist: Code uses the native element and the attributes of the contract

text: Text-bearing components MUST handle Khmer with --line-height-khmer under :lang(km), letter-spacing 0 and no clipping fixed heights.
checklist: The Khmer note names --line-height-khmer; code has a :lang(km) rule where it sets a line height

text: Code MUST implement every state of its spec including focus-visible, locked loading size, error with retry and reduced motion.
checklist: Each state of the spec is in the code; CODE CHECK has no focus-visible or reduced-motion problem

text: The skill MUST NOT build a screen or page and never writes outside the files of its step.
checklist: Only design/components, the component files and design/STATUS.md were written

text: The skill MUST have the ten core layers, each linked from SKILL.md.
The skill MUST be self-contained and name no repository path.
SKILL.md MUST stay within 150 lines with name, description and semver version.
Every relative link MUST point to a file inside the skill folder.
